root_cause.text: In `kvm_vgic_create()`, the initialization of the VGICv3 redistributor region list (`rd_regions`) was performed after a loop that could fail and exit early, leaving the list uninitialized, so subsequent cleanup in `kvm_vgic_dist_destroy()` would dereference an uninitialized list head.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states "If vgic_allocate_private_irqs_locked() fails for any odd reason, we exit kvm_vgic_create() early, leaving dist->rd_regions uninitialised. kvm_vgic_dist_destroy() then comes along and walks into the weeds trying to free the RDs." Patch moves `INIT_LIST_HEAD(&kvm->arch.vgic.rd_regions)` and other initializations before the `kvm_for_each_vcpu` loop, ensuring they are set even on failure paths.
